stops.title: Chɔch Pɔls
stops.caption: Di fo nɔmba dɛn we impɔtant.
stops.speech: Chɔch Pɔls de na di tɔp: branch dɛn, di kɔngrigeshɔn, kɔnfam mɛmba ɛn fɛloship dɛn.

stops.title: I Nid Yu
stops.caption: Di tin dɛn we de wet pan yu.
stops.speech: Dis sɛkshɔn de lis wetin de wet: aproval fɔ gi, branch we nɔ gɛt pasto. Klik fɔ go de.

stops.title: Rɛsɛnt Aktiviti
stops.caption: Udat jɔyn, ɛn we tɛm.
stops.speech: Bilo, rɛsɛnt aktiviti de sho udat rejista ɛn we tɛm, witawt opin ɛni ɔda tin.
